faq_add.q: How many colleges does Pokhara University have, and what is the difference between constituent and affiliated?
faq_add.a: Pokhara University says it has 5 constituent colleges, 3 joint constituent colleges and 58 affiliated colleges. Affiliated colleges are independent private institutions that run PU programmes and follow PU curriculum and exams; a degree from them is awarded by PU (source: the Pokhara University college lists on pu.edu.np). Always check the college admission notice for the programmes it really runs.

faq_add.q: Which four faculties does Pokhara University run?
faq_add.a: Science and Technology and Management Studies (both set up in 1997 under the Pokhara University Act), Humanities and Social Sciences (2004) and Health Sciences (2016). Each faculty has its own list of schools and colleges (source: the Pokhara University college lists on pu.edu.np).

faq_add.q: Which Pokhara University affiliated colleges are in Butwal and the rest of Rupandehi?
faq_add.a: The PU list names Brihaspati College (Bhairahawa), Tilottama Campus (Yogikuti), Crimson College of Technology (Devinagar, Butwal), Lumbini Engineering, Management and Science College (Bhalwari), Axis College (Janakinagar), Siddhartha International College (Butwal-9), Kshitiz International College (Butwal-10) and Butwal Model College (Kataiya) (source: the Pokhara University college lists on pu.edu.np). Programmes differ by college, so confirm the intake first.

faq_add.q: Which Pokhara University colleges are in Pokhara itself?
faq_add.a: LA Grandee International College (Simalchour), Pokhara College of Management (Nadipur), Nepal Tourism and Hotel Management College (Chhinedanda), Gandaki College of Engineering and Science (Lamachaur), Pokhara Engineering College (Phirke) and Himalaya Eye Institute (Gharipatan), plus the PU schools at Dhungepatan (source: the Pokhara University college lists on pu.edu.np).

faq_add.q: Which colleges run Pokhara University health science programmes?
faq_add.a: The Faculty of Health Sciences list names the PU School of Health and Allied Sciences, Tilganga Institute of Ophthalmology (Kathmandu), B.P. Koirala Memorial Cancer Hospital Nursing College (Bharatpur), Himalaya Eye Institute (Pokhara), Modern Technical College, CiST College, Universal Engineering and Science College, National Open College, LA Grandee International College, Crimson College of Technology and Nobel College (source: the Pokhara University college lists on pu.edu.np).

faq_add.q: Where can I study engineering under Pokhara University outside the valley?
faq_add.a: The Faculty of Science and Technology list includes Madan Bhandari Memorial Academy Nepal (Urlabari, Morang), Gandaki College of Engineering and Science and Pokhara Engineering College (Pokhara), Lumbini Engineering, Management and Science College (Rupandehi), Rapti Engineering College (Ghorahi, Dang), United Technical College (Bharatpur), College of Engineering and Management (Nepalgunj), Oxford College of Engineering and Management (Gaidakot) and National Academy of Science and Technology (Dhangadhi) (source: the Pokhara University college lists on pu.edu.np).

faq_add.q: How many colleges are affiliated with the TU Institute of Science and Technology?
faq_add.a: The IoST affiliated college table lists 90 campuses (serial numbers run to 91). Most run B.Sc. CSIT, and the others run the general B.Sc., B.Sc. Microbiology, B.Sc. Environmental Science and B.Tech Food Technology, with some M.Sc. programmes (source: the TU Institute of Science and Technology affiliated college table on iost.tu.edu.np, checked 18 Nov 2026).

faq_add.q: Where can I study B.Sc. Microbiology outside Kathmandu?
faq_add.a: TU IoST lists Birat Multiple College (Biratnagar), Birendra Memorial College and Sunsari Technical College (Dharan), Balkumari College (Narayangadh), Harikhetan Multiple Campus (Birgunj), Model Multiple College (Janakpur), Softech College (Lahan), and in Pokhara Mt. Annapurna Campus, Janapriya Multiple College and Pokhara College of Science and Technology (source: the TU Institute of Science and Technology affiliated college table on iost.tu.edu.np).

faq_add.q: Which colleges offer B.Tech Food Technology outside the valley?
faq_add.a: TU IoST lists Birat Multiple College (Biratnagar), Dharan Multiple Campus and Sunsari Technical College (Dharan), Nilgiri College (Itahari), Nagarik College (Gaidakot) and Pokhara College of Science and Technology (source: the TU Institute of Science and Technology affiliated college table on iost.tu.edu.np). In the valley the list names National College (NIST), National College of Food Technology, Padmashree International College, Lalitpur Valley College and GoldenGate International College.

faq_add.q: Where can I study B.Sc. Environmental Science in Nepal?
faq_add.a: TU IoST lists Damak Multiple Campus (Jhapa), Balkumari College and Saptagandaki Multiple Campus (Chitwan), Harikhetan Multiple Campus (Birgunj), Janapriya Multiple College (Pokhara), and in Kathmandu valley College of Applied Sciences (Anamnagar), Khwopa College (Bhaktapur) and Xavier International College (Kalopul). College of Applied Sciences and GoldenGate also list M.Sc. Environmental Science (source: the TU Institute of Science and Technology affiliated college table on iost.tu.edu.np).

faq_add.q: Where can I study the general B.Sc. in Sudurpashchim and Karnali?
faq_add.a: TU IoST lists Kailali Multiple Campus and Aishwarya Multiple Campus (Dhangadhi), Gokuleshwor Multiple Campus (Darchula), Manilek Campus (Baitadi) and Karnali Prabidhi Campus (Sipkhana, Kalikot) for the general B.Sc. (source: the TU Institute of Science and Technology affiliated college table on iost.tu.edu.np). Confirm the current intake with the campus because a listing is not a guarantee of an open seat.
